agent.problem: Nothing in the earlier cards identifies David or gives the baker a basis for choosing him over Saul. The blank therefore asks for wording the baker has not seen and can only guess, rather than a meaning supported by the setup.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

agent.problem: "He" and "his kingdom" depend on the child mentioned on card 14, but that story card is no longer visible. The question needs to identify the child itself.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.
